description: This file implements a stock ageing report for ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and chart generation related to stock age analysis.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate stock ageing report data and chart.

methods.name: get_average_age
methods.description: Calculates the average age of stock batches in the FIFO queue.

methods.name: get_range_age
methods.description: Determines stock quantities within specified age ranges.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_fifo_queue
methods.description: Builds FIFO queue of stock batches from stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database.

methods.name: get_item_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for item filtering.

methods.name: get_sle_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for stock ledger entry filtering.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for the age distribution chart.

methods.name: setup_ageing_columns
methods.description: Sets up age range columns for the report.

methods.name: add_column
methods.description: Helper to add a column definition to range columns.
